title: Künefe
description: A spectacular Turkish dessert of crisp golden kadayıf pastry surrounding stretchy melted cheese, finished with fragrant syrup and premium pistachios.

ingredients.title: Künefe
items: 250 g unsalted mozzarella or künefe cheese

instruction.title: Prepare the Syrup
steps: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add lemon juice and simmer for another 2 minutes.
Stir in rose water and remove from the heat.
Allow the syrup to cool.

instruction.title: Prepare the Kadayıf
steps: Separate the kadayıf strands gently with your fingers.
Melt the clarified butter and mix it thoroughly through the pastry.
Make sure every strand is lightly coated.

instruction.title: Build the Künefe
steps: Butter a 24 cm heavy ovenproof pan or künefe dish.
Press half of the buttered kadayıf firmly into the bottom.
Spread the cheese evenly across the center, leaving a small border.
Cover completely with the remaining kadayıf.
Press the surface firmly and evenly.

instruction.title: Cook Until Golden
steps: Cook over medium-low heat until the bottom becomes deeply golden and crisp.
Rotate the pan regularly for even browning.
Place under a hot broiler briefly to finish the top.
Continue until the surface is intensely golden and the cheese is completely melted.

instruction.title: Finish and Serve
steps: Immediately pour the cooled syrup evenly over the hot künefe.
Allow it to absorb for 1 to 2 minutes.
Scatter finely ground pistachios over the surface.
Cut into portions and serve immediately while the cheese remains molten and stretchy.

servingSuggestions.title: Restaurant-Style Presentation
items: Finish generously with finely ground pistachios.
Present while the cheese is still molten.
Serve with a small portion of kaymak or clotted cream.
Pair with Turkish tea or strong Turkish coffee.

chefTips: Use fresh kadayıf whenever possible for the best texture.
Butter the pastry thoroughly so every strand becomes crisp.
Press both layers firmly to create a compact, even dessert.
Cook slowly over medium-low heat so the base browns without burning.
Use a mild, low-salt cheese that melts and stretches well.
The key contrast is a deeply crisp exterior with molten cheese inside.
Pour cool syrup over hot künefe for maximum crispness.
Serve immediately; künefe loses its signature texture as it cools.
